capabilities: Import a local CSV notice list and map DOI, notice type, and notice date columns
Match reference notes by a DOI property, ignoring case and DOI prefixes
Find affected manuscripts through native links and Pandoc citekeys like [@Lee2020]
Track per-item checked state keyed on note path, DOI, notice type, and date
Export a dated local JSON report and save per-file column maps (Pro)
extras: Freemium: core matching is free; Pro features (saved column maps, JSON report export) require a GitHub Sponsors sponsorship, verified via GitHub device-flow sign-in that sends no vault data. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4+. The What's new tab opened after updates suggests other NoteMods plugins and links to notemods.com; testing covered macOS only, and the plugin scans on demand without monitoring CSV changes.
problem: Obsidian has no way to check whether the papers cited in a vault's reference notes have retraction or correction notices and which manuscripts they affect.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 one-time)

summary: Retraction notice matcher that cross-checks a local CSV against reference note DOIs and queues manuscripts linked to flagged papers for review.
